    • getEnumValueOfMethod

      public Optional<MethodElement> getEnumValueOfMethod()
      Description copied from interface: EnumElement
      Returns the static method used to resolve an enum constant by name.

      Java enums use the standard Enum.valueOf(Class, String) path and therefore return an empty optional. Language implementations can expose their compiler-modelled lookup method so generated introspections can resolve constants without reflection.

      Specified by:
      getEnumValueOfMethod in interface EnumElement
      Returns:
      The enum constant lookup method, if one is available
